verdict.rationale: llama.cpp documents 1.5- to 8-bit integer quantization (gh-8), which covers INT4, and community users run its own GGUF quant types such as Q6_K (comm-11). However, all evidenced loading goes through GGUF models (gh-1, gh-2), and nothing shows it can directly load FP8, GPTQ, or AWQ checkpoints. Missing for 10: FP8 support, GPTQ loading, AWQ loading, any evidence of loading non-GGUF quantized formats.
